name: esp32s3_core
summary: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8 module with Espressif's peripheral circuit: 22 uF + 0.1 uF on 3V3, EN RC delay (10 kohm, 1 uF), USB D-/D+ through series resistors; exposes EN, IO0, USB, UART0 and ten general GPIOs.

sources.document: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & WROOM-1U Datasheet, section 9 Peripheral Schematics (figure 9-1: C1 22 uF and C3 0.1 uF on VDD33; EN RC delay R = 10 kohm, C = 1 uF)
ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & WROOM-1U Datasheet, figure 11-1 Recommended PCB Land Pattern: the antenna area is the top 6 mm of the 18 x 25.5 mm module

KiCad footprint RF_Module:ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 (KiCad 10.0.5 library): courtyard drawn with a KEEP-OUT ZONE x -24..24 mm, y -27.75..-6.75 mm around the antenna (module outline x -9..9, y -12.75..12.75 on F.Fab)
ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & WROOM-1U Datasheet, table 6-2 Recommended Operating Conditions (VDD33 3.0-3.6 V, I_VDD >= 0.5 A)
ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & WROOM-1U Datasheet, table 3-1 Pin Definitions
ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & WROOM-1U Datasheet, section 4 Boot Configurations (GPIO0 and GPIO46 boot mode, GPIO45 VDD_SPI, GPIO3 JTAG source; unconnected strapping pins take their internal pulls)
Espressif ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines, section 1.3.13 USB: GPIO19/GPIO20 are D-/D+; reserve series resistors (initial value 22/33 ohm) and capacitors to ground, close to the chip
Espressif ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines, section 1.3.13: USB_D+ fluctuates at power-up; add an external pull-up if a stable initial state is needed
Espressif ESP32-S3 Hardware Design Guidelines, PCB layout: a four-layer PCB design is recommended

ports.name: v3v3
ports.note: the supply must also deliver at least 0.5 A (table 6-2)

ports.name: en
ports.note: chip enable; high = on, low = reset

ports.name: io0
ports.note: strapping pin: low at reset selects download boot

notes.text: Module pins used: GND 1/40 and EPAD 41, 3V3 2, EN 3, IO0 27, USB D- 13 (IO19), USB D+ 14 (IO20), RXD0 36, TXD0 37, IO4-IO9 and IO15-IO18. The other pins are left unconnected.
Strapping pins GPIO3, GPIO45 and GPIO46 are left unconnected, so their internal pulls set the defaults; GPIO0 is exposed as 'io0' for a boot button.
EN RC delay R = 10 kohm, C = 1 uF is Espressif's usual setting; it may need adjusting to the supply's power-up timing.
USB series resistors 22 ohm (Espressif's initial value); the optional capacitors to ground are not fitted, as Espressif's figure marks them not populated initially.
USB_D+ fluctuates at power-up; no pull-up is added here.

Antenna keep-out: no other part and no copper in x -24..24, y -27.75..-6.75 mm of the module frame (KiCad's drawn zone, which contains Espressif's 18 x 6 mm antenna area). Placement keeps parts out of it and the router keeps tracks and vias out on both layers.
Espressif recommends a four-layer PCB for ESP32-S3 designs; Copper currently makes two-layer boards with no ground plane (scope: G-050).
